title: Process Improvement Manager (f/m/d)
description:
Lead continuous improvement across our fulfilment centres.

What you'll do
- Identify and size improvement opportunities with Lean tools
- Run kaizen events with site teams
- Own the improvement pipeline and report savings to the COO

What you bring
- 5+ years in operational excellence or process improvement
- Lean Six Sigma Green or Black Belt
- SQL and a BI tool
- Business English at C1 level is required, as the leadership team and reporting language is English
